visualCharacteristics.purpose: Report or analyst-asset tiles: cover image above a title and a "Read the report" CTA; whole card clickable
visualCharacteristics.description: Repeating structure of two identical image + title + CTA tiles side by side.

contentPattern.structure: Repeating rows, one per report: cell 1 = cover image; cell 2 = heading (H2) and a paragraph holding only the CTA link

cells: H2 'Adobe is the leader in content supply chain solutions.'; link 'Read the report' to /resources/reports/everest-group-content-supply-chain-revolutionizing-the-content-development-lifecycle.html
H2 'Turn content into a growth engine with AI.'; link 'Read the report' to /resources/sdk/growth-unlock-turning-content-into-a-growth-engine-with-ai.html

usage: Use for 2-up analyst report / ebook promos with a cover image, title and one CTA.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image + title + single CTA tiles. The first link-only paragraph becomes the card link.
